caseName: Staats v. American Civil Liberties Union, Inc.
caseNameFull: Staats, Comptroller General v. American Civil Liberties Union, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. D. C. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 417 U. S. 944.] Application for stay of order of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia pending final disposition of this case, presented to The Chief Justice and by him referred to the Court, granted.
